info.title: Partly HTTP API
info.description: Dashboard administration and SDK policy/usage transport. Evaluation runs locally in SDKs. JSON request bodies are limited to 16 KiB; policies to 1 MiB. Sessions expire after 12 hours or server restart. Cross-site API requests are rejected; HTTPS adds Secure to session cookies. Host and Origin checks use the actual listener, never forwarded headers.

get.summary: Download the application policy; authenticate before checking If-None-Match.
get.description:
A 200 contains the complete selected policy and a quoted SHA-256 content ETag.
Identical saves and changes outside the application selection keep its ETag unchanged.
The revision increases only when that application's selected policy changes.
A confirmed key_revoked response clears SDK policy even if the ETag matched;
ordinary errors preserve the last accepted snapshot.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Previously accepted quoted ETag; weak tags, lists and wildcard are supported
